panel.title: Display Arrange
panel.subtitle: Position each display relative to the primary one
panel.confirm-text: New layout applied — reverting in {seconds}s if not confirmed

row.direction-hint: Position relative to the primary display
row.direction-left: Place to the left of the primary display
row.direction-right: Place to the right of the primary display

mode.extend-desc: Extend the desktop across all displays
mode.duplicate-desc: Show the same image on all displays
mode.duplicate-unavailable-desc: Mirroring is not supported at runtime — niri only allows this via config.kdl

settings.refresh-interval-desc: How often to poll niri for connected-output changes
settings.auto-reapply-desc: Automatically re-apply the saved arrangement whenever the set of connected displays changes
